newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on dollar's gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on dollar's gains.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Monday, lifted by short-covering in reaction to the dollar's rise against the yen, traders said.
Benchmark January rubber ended at 124.0 yen after opening at 122.2 yen. Other prices ranged from 2.5 yen to 5.0 yen per kg higher.
"The dollar's rise against the yen forced private investors to cover their shorts from the opening," one trader said.
Traders said near-term market direction hinges on the currency market.
